al_desc: Who is behind bisne.es and the terms for using this website.
al_datos_p: In compliance with Spanish Law 34/2002 on information society services and electronic commerce, these are the details of the owner of bisne.es:
al_datos_li: Owner: Autarquico Labs S.L.U., the company behind Autarqui.co.
al_objeto_p: This website explains what bisne is and offers a conversation with an artificial intelligence assistant and a form to leave your email and join the waiting list. Its content is informative: it is not the provision of the services nor legal, tax or employment advice, and it may change before we open.
al_uso_p: By using this website you accept this notice and the privacy policy. Use it lawfully, without interfering with how it works or trying to access non-public parts, and without automating conversations with the assistant.
al_propiedad_p: The bisne brand, the logo, the texts, the design and the rest of this website's content belong to Autarquico Labs S.L.U. or are used with permission. They may not be reproduced, distributed or transformed without authorisation, except to use the website personally.
al_responsabilidad_p: We take care that the information is clear and up to date, but it may contain errors or become outdated. The assistant's answers are generated by an artificial intelligence model: they are guidance, not a commitment or professional advice. We are not responsible for the content of third-party websites we link to.
al_ley_p: This notice is governed by Spanish law. For any dispute, unless the law provides otherwise, the courts of the user's place of residence have jurisdiction when the user is a consumer.
title: bisne. · One app to run your business
desc: bisne runs your bookings, customers, invoices, taxes and staff in one place. Tell us what takes up your time.
mensaje: One app to run your business.
cta_pregunta: Tell us what takes up your time.
baja: bisne runs your bookings, customers, invoices, taxes and staff in one place. You review and decide.
espera: We're opening little by little: the first to sign up get in sooner and help shape it.
producto_titulo: Ask the way you'd say it. bisne gets it ready.
producto_p: The assistant works alongside you, with your permissions: it finds, prepares and leaves every change ready for you to confirm. Nothing that matters happens without your OK.
v_clientes_p: Marta asks for an appointment on WhatsApp and the assistant offers her a slot. With one sentence, you message every customer booked this week, each on their own channel.
v_clientes_alt: Video: the assistant offers a customer an appointment on WhatsApp and sends a message to 23 customers.
v_personal_p: You ask to bring payroll forward and the assistant prepares it from the month's clock-ins. You confirm and the bank payment batch is ready.
v_personal_alt: Video: the assistant prepares 14 payslips from clock-ins and gets the payment batch ready.
v_impuestos_p: bisne reminds you a tax is due, prepares the draft from your invoices and expenses, and sends it to your advisor to review.
v_impuestos_alt: Video: the assistant flags an IGIC deadline and sends the draft to the advisor.
modulos_titulo: Start with what weighs on you most.
modulos_p: Eight modules. You only take the ones you need, and each one works on its own.
m_clientes_p: Win customers, look after them, organise their bookings and get them coming back.
m_personal_p: Clock-ins, payroll and Social Security up to date. You know what's due, who's on it and what's waiting for your OK.
m_web_p: A professional website you publish from your phone, that shows up when people search for you.
m_facturacion_p: Create invoices, keep track of payments and keep your accounts up to date.
m_impuestos_p: Quarterly drafts prepared from what's already in bisne, with a reminder before every deadline.
m_asesor_p: Knows your business and recommends what to do: from your team to your ads.
m_subvenciones_p: Find grants for your business and manage how to apply for them.
m_conecta_p: Connect your business to the tools and services you already use.
d_clientes_titulo: Look after your customers and grow.
d_clientes_p: Customers brings together everything you need: where they come from, their bookings, what you talk about and what they like.
d_facturacion_titulo: Invoice without templates and know who owes you.
d_facturacion_p: Invoicing prepares your invoices and shows you at a glance what's been paid and what hasn't.
d_facturacion_1_p: By chat or voice note; you review and issue.
d_facturacion_2_p: They become an invoice when the customer accepts.
d_facturacion_3_p: VAT or IGIC and withholding, with your customers saved.
d_facturacion_5_p: Invoices arrive from email or WhatsApp.
d_facturacion_6_p: bisne suggests each match; you confirm.
d_impuestos_p: Taxes prepares the drafts from what's already in bisne. Nothing is filed without approval.

d_impuestos_2_p: VAT, IGIC, income tax, withholdings and the annual return.
d_impuestos_3_p: You or your adviser review before filing.
d_impuestos_5_p: They see what you see, without asking you for paperwork.
d_personal_titulo: Your team, up to date and paper-free.
d_personal_p: Staff brings together clock-ins, payroll and Social Security: you know what's due, who's on it and what's waiting for your OK.
d_personal_4_p: Paperwork and obligations up to date.
d_personal_5_p: You know what's waiting for your approval.
d_asesor_titulo: An advisor who knows your business.
d_asesor_p: Advisor combines what happens in bisne with what you connect, and recommends what to do, from adjusting your team to spending more on ads. The more you connect, the better it knows you.
d_asesor_1_p: Sales, expenses, bookings and team, together.
d_asesor_2_p: Spots what's changing before you feel it.
d_asesor_3_p: Adjust shifts, cut costs or raise your ads, with the reasons.
d_asesor_4_p: “Is it worth opening on Saturdays?”, by chat.
d_asesor_5_p: The more you connect, the better its advice.
d_asesor_6_p: It suggests; nothing changes without your OK.
d_subvenciones_titulo: The grants that fit you, without hunting for them.
d_subvenciones_p: Grants looks for funding based on your business profile and stays with you until you apply.
d_subvenciones_1_p: Based on your profile and your activity.
d_subvenciones_2_p: Only those that suit your business.
d_subvenciones_3_p: What's needed and how to submit it.
d_subvenciones_4_p: Deadlines and status of each application.
d_web_p: Website builds your site from your phone, with no technical skills, and helps you show up when people search.
d_web_1_p: A draft based on how you describe your business.
d_web_2_p: On Google and on AI search engines.
d_web_3_p: Details, opening hours, photos and reviews.
d_web_4_p: What they bring you, without touching code.
d_conecta_titulo: Keep using what you already use.
d_conecta_p: Conecta links your program or POS to bisne, with no migration.
d_conecta_2_p: Every figure shows where it came from and when it was read.
d_conecta_3_p: Writing to your program needs approval.
q_todo: Do I have to take everything?
a_todo: No. You take the modules you need, one by one, and each one is useful on its own.
a_asesoria: No. Your advisor can log in to bisne and see what you see. For taxes, nothing is filed without your approval or theirs.
q_espana: Is it right for my business?
a_espana: If you're self-employed or run a small business in Spain, Canary Islands included, yes: it's built for how things work here.
a_precio: Prices haven't been published yet. Tell us what you need and the team will write to you.
a_cuando: We're opening little by little. Sign up now and you'll be among the first in.
cierre_p: Tell us what takes up your time and we'll show you how bisne takes it off your hands. It takes a couple of minutes.

priv_desc: How we handle what you tell us in the conversation and your email when you leave it.
priv_resp_p: Autarquico Labs S.L.U., tax ID B93768125, the company behind Autarqui.co. Registered address: {{pend}}. Contact: hola@bisne.es.
priv_datos_li: What you write in the conversation with the AI assistant.
Your email and, if you leave it, a summary of your business (type, size, what takes up your time), when you use the contact card or the short form.
The date, the language of the page and the version of the notice you accepted.
A fingerprint of your IP address, not the address itself, to limit automated submissions.
If you leave your email, the conversation up to that point as you wrote it, which is sent right away by email to the bisne team.
priv_cookies: We use no cookies and no analytics. We only store in your browser whether you prefer the light or the dark theme.
priv_ia_p: The answers are generated by an artificial intelligence model. What you write is sent to DeepSeek and, if it does not answer, to Anthropic. DeepSeek processes data outside the European Economic Area; basis for that transfer: {{pend}}. Before sending it we replace the personal data we recognise (emails, phone numbers, documents and, mostly in Spanish, names), but in other languages some names may remain. Your email from the card or the form is never sent to the model.
priv_para_p: To answer you, to let you know when bisne launches and to tune the assistant. The basis is your consent: the notice you accept before talking and the privacy checkbox when you leave your email. If you leave your email, also so the team can study your case from the conversation.
priv_tiempo_p: Conversations are kept for 30 days with personal data replaced by labels, without your email or your IP; the original text is deleted when the conversation closes or expires. Sign-ups and copies of emails: {{pend}}. The emails with the conversation that the team receives are kept in its mailbox while we handle your request; final period: {{pend}}.
priv_quien_li: Cloudflare Turnstile: checks that you are a person. It loads only when you press «Talk to us» or open the form, and Cloudflare receives technical data about your connection.
Email provider: sends the confirmation and notification emails. Name and location: {{pend}}.
Hosting: this site is served from GitHub Pages, which receives your IP address when the page loads.
priv_derechos_p: You can access your data, correct it, ask us to delete it, object or withdraw your consent at any time. To unsubscribe, write to hola@bisne.es. If you think we have not handled your data properly, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).

c_limite_enviado: We have reached the limit of this conversation. We already have your email: the team will write to you.

c_motivo_no_disponible: The assistant is not available right now.
c_motivo_limite_ip: Too many requests have been made from your connection.

c_error_priv: Tick the box to be able to send it.

c_t_h: Leave your email with the bisne team

c_t_no_anuncio: Understood. No contact has been saved.

c_t_sin_propuesta: The summary can no longer be sent. You can keep talking or use the short form.
